footprints.description: C&K PTS845 4.5 x 3.4 mm SMT side-actuated tactile switch; terminals 1 and 3 are one pin
footprints.note: littelfuse-c-k-tactile-pts845-series-datasheet p.1 (with peg) / p.2 (without peg) PCB LAYOUT, same terminal lands; also PTS845.pdf p.2. Terminals 1, 2, 3 in a row: 1, 3 0.75 wide (inner 1.70, outer 3.20 -> centres +/-1.225), 2 0.6 wide at 0, all 1.80 long, from the peg-hole line back. Circuit diagram p.1: 1 and 3 joined, so datasheet terminal 3 is drawn as a second pad of pin 1 (pin 2 = terminal 2). Bracket tabs (5.00 / 2.40, 0.90) and 2x 0.90 peg holes not drawn. y: peg line 0.35 behind the body centre (side view p.1: front 0 to back 3.4, plate 0.85 + 1.2 to the peg centre = 2.05), so pads y -2.15..-0.35; body 4.5 x 3.4 (4 without brackets), actuator side (front) down [series using it: PTS845]

footprints.description: C&K PTS847 4.6 x 2.6 mm edge-mount side-actuated tactile switch; terminals 1 and 3 are one pin
footprints.note: littelfuse-c-k-tactile-pts847-series-datasheet p.2 P.C.B Layout (standard): terminals 1, 2, 3 0.8 wide (inner 1.5, outer 3.1 -> centres +/-1.15, 0), 1.25 long (3.0 to 1.75 from the board edge). Circuit p.2: 1 and 3 joined, so terminal 3 is a second pad of pin 1. The board needs a 3.8 x 1.35 cut-out at its edge (not drawable here); the two hold-down pads beside it (5.6 outer) and, for the L version (p.3), the plated shield slots are not drawn; p.3 does not dimension the L version's terminal pad length, the p.2 lands are used for both. Body = top-view outline 4.6 wide x 2.6 deep (actuator tip 0.35 past the board edge, back 2.25 inside, from the side view 1.7 / 2.6), so the pads sit at y -1.425 from the body centre; actuator side down [series using it: PTS847]
